persona: Agency content writer with three years of SEO blog writing for travel and D2C brands
resumeText:
Ananya Sharma | Jaipur | ananya.sharma@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Content Writer, Thar Digital Media, Jaipur (2023 - present)
- Write long-form travel blogs and website content writing for hotel and D2C clients, about 12 pieces a month.
- Do keyword research in Ubersuggest and plan SEO blogs around search intent for each client.
- Add meta titles, H2 structure and internal links as part of on-page SEO before submission.
- Handle proofreading and copy editing for two junior writers against the house style guide.
- Present monthly content performance to clients and agree the next month's topics with them.

Freelance Writer, self-employed, Jaipur (2022 - 2023)
- Wrote product descriptions for small fashion sellers.

EDUCATION
BA English, University of Rajasthan, 2022

SKILLS
Content briefs, Grammarly, Google Docs
